limitations: The expanded board was captured in IAB. Full raw UI text is retained in the conversation tool output/runtime, not fully serialized in this file. This is not a complete-board decision record.
387 additional football outcomes were one-provider screened; 332 had indicative two-provider prices. These are screening arithmetic, not full live allocator certification.
38 MLB outcomes were screened; Cincinnati/Milwaukee has ESPN 08:40 vs Betman/Kalshi 08:45 start mismatch and is excluded from any recommendation.
La Liga Sep 11/12 and Lazio/Milan, Sassuolo/Juventus Kalshi contract dates differ from Betman/ESPN. Such joins excluded from two-source screening.
KBO/NPB tie-resolution wording on Kalshi is 50/50, so not fed into a binary Betman consensus without rule reconciliation. Future NPB books were wide and often inactive.
K League 1 Kalshi markets had minimal trade volume; K League 2 searches found single-source/aggregate odds without two fresh independently attributable exact quotes.
Asian Games basketball public odds found; regular-time/OT wording and timestamps not fully reconciled. No stake assigned.
Handicap, 1H, win-by-one, SUM and unmatched total lines not modeled; cannot infer probabilities by moving a total/spread line.
No exhaustive legal-parlay enumeration: no full-board PASS or best-available claim.

Ended 9/10 winning parlay has unknown actual odds/payout: excluded from spendable cash and sports risk exposure; its 1000 bookkeeping pending stake would bring equity at cost to45570, same 2000 base, but price floors here conservatively use44570.
